verdict.rationale: The only well-documented natural-language capability is a hosted MCP server that lets AI tools search the Medusa documentation, not operate the commerce product. The pricing page names a "Cloud Development Agent" and "Medusa MCP and Cloud CLI", and the homepage mentions "guardrails for agents to build customizations", which hints at agent-driven building but gives no detail. Missing for 10: documented natural-language operation of store data and admin tasks (products, orders, inventory), details on what the Cloud Development Agent and Medusa MCP actually do, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
